sharedContext.reasoning: The agent is asking for both tree identification (generic) and lateral distance measurements from trees to overhead conductors (measurement). Since the checklist requirement fundamentally hinges on whether clearance distances meet the 10-foot or 50-foot thresholds, and the agent is explicitly requesting distance measurements as part of the verification, the measurement component is the primary routing need.
